worldcombat.skill.nightmare.summary: Gives an already sleeping opponent nightmares: every so often it drains a share of the target's maximum health and holds it down in sleep so it cannot wake. It only works on a sleeping target, and the drain is a share of maximum health ignoring defence and type; to save the sleeper you must clear the nightmare, or down or drive off the caster — the latter only stops the draining, while the nightmare mark still runs out on its own.
worldcombat.skill.nightmare.use.0: Cash in a sleep window you or an ally made
worldcombat.skill.nightmare.use.1: Press steady health loss onto a sleeper
worldcombat.skill.nightmare.use.2: Force an opponent to spend a cleanse or come protect the sleeper
Curses only an already sleeping enemy within %1$s blocks and a clear line; every %3$s it drains %2$s of the target's maximum health (each later pulse 20%% lighter). It settles as a share of maximum health, with neither defence nor type involved, but a higher Sp. Def drains less.

The nightmare lasts %1$s; while it remains the target is held asleep, and being woken by damage is quickly pressed back down. Once it runs out or is cleared, the draining and the sleep press stop and sleep is no longer renewed; a target already carrying a nightmare cannot be cursed again.
worldcombat.skill.nightmare.deep.on: Deep dream: each drain ×1.15, but total length ×0.8 (fewer pulses), +2 ticks wind-up and +6 ticks cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.nightmare.deep.off: Long dream: each drain ×0.85, but total length ×1.25 and more pulses.
worldcombat.skill.nightmare.growth.1: From level %1$s each drain %2$s and the reach %3$s.
worldcombat.skill.nightmare.preference.d: On: each drain ×1.15, but total length ×0.8 (fewer pulses), +2 ticks wind-up and +6 ticks cooldown — a quick harvest. Off (long dream): each drain ×0.85, but total length ×1.25 and more pulses — a slow grind.
worldcombat.skill.nightmare.preference.a: Beyond this distance from a sleeping target the priority drops to 36 and the partner walks into position before cursing (it still casts); larger lets it press in from farther away.
When on, the partner will also leave its post to curse.
